note: BEFORE = 2bbe607 (pre-ODE-429) served from a git worktree on :3001. AFTER = dd745a0 on :3000. Same machine, same browser, interleaved runs.

reading.time_to_interactive: no regression. domInteractive 98/71/154 before vs 98/65/100 after; first-paint 108/72/156 before vs 96/68/108 after.
reading.first_contentful_paint: deferred by ~280ms, consistently. The auth card enters with the prototype's odFadeUp, which starts at opacity 0, so the first paint of content is one animation away. The delta matches the 280ms animation duration.
reading.verdict: Interactivity, request count and bytes are equal or better. The FCP shift is the prototype-specified entrance animation, not work added to the boot path, and prefers-reduced-motion removes it entirely.
reading.splash: adds no time to startup: it renders while getSession resolves and is replaced the moment it does, with no timer between the two (pinned by tests/desktop-startup-splash.test.tsx).
